text:
michael: Heads-up — PR #8032 is blocked, CI integration shard 7 failing with `scheduler.test.ts` intermittently. Screenshot/log below.
ci-bot: [ci] integration/shard7 FAILED — test scheduler.test.ts
michael: Logs show `TypeError: Cannot read property 'queue' of undefined` at Scheduler.enqueue (scheduler.ts:142)
rachel: Re-run requested. Triggering rebuild now.
ci-bot: Re-run queued by rachel — rebuild in progress.
ci-bot: Re-run completed — all integration shards GREEN except shard 7 still failing (2/5)
sam: I see a snapshot mismatch in `src/ui/__snapshots__/dialog.test.snap` from the same PR — small whitespace change that matches maya's refactor.
maya: That snapshot change is intentional from my refactor. Safe to update snapshot. I'll approve the snapshot update.
sam: OK will update snapshot and push.
michael: About the flaky scheduler test — prefer not to label flaky yet. Can someone run `yarn test scheduler --runInBand --retries=0 --repeat 50` locally? I can run it after lunch.
rachel: CI passed on a full rerun once (green) — but shard 7 has historical flakes. My recommendation: merge after one green CI and open tracking issue with logs and steps to reproduce.
sam: I'll open the issue and add `infra:flake` + assign to eng-qa. https://github.com/redwood-inference/issues/1245
maya: Approving the PR now. :thumbsup:
michael: LGTM. Approving too.
ci-bot: Merge check: approvals=2, required_approvals=2, CI=passing -> ready to merge.
rachel: I'll merge in the low-traffic window at 15:30 UTC and annotate the merge with the follow-up issue.
sam: Follow-up issue created with full logs and failure histogram. I'll dig into scheduler queue timing tomorrow.
michael: Action items: 1) merge after 15:30 UTC if CI green, 2) sam owns flake issue #1245, 3) maya will push snapshot update. Thanks everyone.
